Gives the view matrix of a camera: the one of [SetCameraViewMatrix](SetCameraViewMatrix), or the one of the camera entity (from the world to where the entity is and how it is turned). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@returns The view matrix, from the world to the camera.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 5, 0, 0
Local view:FloatMatrix4x3 = GetCameraViewMatrix(camera)
Print view[3][0] ; -5.0
```
